description_en: Settings the audit log switch or log storage duration for an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance
description_zh: 设置MongoDB实例的审计日志开关或日志存储时长
kebab_example: aliyun dds modify-audit-policy --db-instance-id dds-bp1785659e3f0000 --audit-status enable --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyAuditPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The status of audit logging. Valid values:
enable: Enables audit logging.
disabled: Disables audit logging
parameters.help_zh:
审计日志状态，取值：
enable：开启审计日志。
disabled：关闭审计日志
parameters.name: audit_status

parameters.help_en:
In the Standard edition, this parameter specifies the retention period of audit logs. Valid values: 1 to 365. Default value: 30. Unit: days.

In the V2_Standard edition (DAS Enterprise Edition NoSQL-compatible audit logs), this parameter specifies the cold storage duration of audit logs. Valid values: 30, 180, 365, 1095, and 1825. Unit: days
parameters.help_zh:
在Standard（正式版）版本中，为审计日志保留时长。取值范围为1~365天，默认为30天。

在V2_Standard（DAS企业版(NOSQL兼容)审计日志）版本中，为审计日志冷存储天数，取值范围为30、180、365、1095、1825，单位天
parameters.name: storage_period

parameters.help_en: The source of the audit log request. Valid value: Console
parameters.help_zh: 审计日志的请求来源，取值为Console
parameters.name: audit_log_switch_source

parameters.help_en:
The edition of audit logging. Valid values:

Trial: Free Trial edition.
Standard: Standard edition.
V2_Standard: DAS Enterprise Edition (NoSQL-compatible) audit logs.
The default value is Trial. Starting from January 6, 2022, the Standard edition of audit logs is gradually rolled out across regions, and applications for the Free Trial edition are no longer accepted.
Starting from February 2026, DAS Enterprise Edition (NoSQL-compatible) audit logs are gradually rolled out across regions, and applications for the Standard edition are no longer accepted
parameters.help_zh:
审计日志的版本类型。

Trial：免费试用版。
Standard：正式版。
V2_Standard ：DAS企业版(NOSQL兼容)审计日志。
该参数的默认值为Trial。从2022年01月06日起，各地域将陆续上线正式版审计日志，并终止申请免费试用版审计日志。
从2026年2月起，各地域将陆续上线DAS企业版(NOSQL兼容)审计日志，并终止申请正式版审计日志
parameters.name: service_type

parameters.help_en: This parameter takes effect only in the V2_Standard edition (DAS Enterprise Edition NoSQL-compatible audit logs) and specifies the hot storage duration of audit logs. Valid values: 0 to 7. Unit: days
parameters.help_zh: 在V2_Standard（DAS企业版(NOSQL兼容)审计日志）版本中生效，为审计日志热存储天数，取值范围为0-7，单位天
parameters.name: hot_storage_period
